educationalGoal: In this course, students will acquire the ability to discuss various topics in English. In order to do this, students will learn necessary English vocabulary and expressions, sentence structures, and reading skills.
advice: Students will use a textbook to study various topics. Textbook: Reading Explorer 2 Third Edition Unit 1: Food and Health Unit 2: Call of the Wild Unit 3: History Detectives Unit 4: Traditions and Rituals In class, students are expected to have a positive attitude, to work in pairs or groups, to play English games, to prepare and conduct presentations, and to participate in other active learning activities. Before each class, students must check Moodle or the e-syllabus for any homework or other materials needed for class.

activityGoals.body: Read and understand the contents of the topics studied in class.
For each topic, understand the meaning of important words and phrases and be able to use them correctly.
Understand the main point of sentences and be able to explain the meaning, orally and in writing.
Be able to explain one's opinion about the topics studied in class, orally and in writing.
Improve one's English skills by cooperatively working in groups or pairs.

achievementLevels.ideal: - Can thoroughly understand the content of the topics studied. - Can understand and correctly use the important vocabulary and expressions from each topic. - Can identify the main point of sentences and correctly explain it in English, orally or in writing. - Can accurately express one's opinion about the topics studied, orally or in writing. - Cooperates with groups/partners with a positive attitude to complete activities to improve English skills.
